item.title: She Served Beef Wellington. Three Relatives Never Came Home.
item.description: Erin Patterson invited family members to lunch and served a Beef Wellington containing toxic mushrooms. Three guests died, one survived, and in 2025 she was found guilty of three murders and one attempted murder.

item.title: She Used Their Daughter To Set Him Up
item.description:
Danny Cahalane was attacked with sulphuric acid at his Plymouth home in February 2025 while his young daughter slept upstairs. He died in hospital ten weeks later. Investigators discovered that his ex-partner, Paris Wilson, had passed information about his whereabouts to a criminal gang over a drug debt of around £120,000. She was convicted of manslaughter and an earlier attempted kidnapping, while two men were convicted of Danny’s murder. Wilson was sentenced to nine years in prison in July 2026.
How could someone who knew him so well become part of the plan that led to his death?v
